title: ever MARYAM|Long Lantern Sleeves Waist Applique Chiffon Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your evening look with our Long Lantern Sleeves Waist Applique Chiffon Formal Dress. This elegant dress features flowing chiffon fabric, long lantern sleeves for a touch of drama, and a beautifully detailed waist applique that enhances your silhouette. The perfect combination of grace and sophistication, this dress is ideal for formal events where you want to make a lasting impression.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Ankle length.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
